ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a familiar
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A mage of the colony without a familiar wants one of the colony's animals bound to them, and the time to spend with it.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {OTHER_nameDef} is {FOR_nameDef}'s familiar: once promised, {FOR_nameDef} stays with it a while in a quiet hour of the day, and it is bound.

plain.li: The magic sits better with something alive beside it. {OTHER_nameDef} already follows me about; let me bind it properly.
Every mage I ever learned from had a familiar. I'd like an hour with {OTHER_nameDef}, and then it would be mine.
[lowmood] The mana comes slow and lonely lately. A familiar would help, and {OTHER_nameDef} would do.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I understand each other already. Binding it would only say so out loud.

blunt.li: I need a familiar. {OTHER_nameDef} is the one. An hour of quiet is all it takes.

cheerful.li: Picture it: me at the bench, {OTHER_nameDef} glowing at my feet. Say yes.

gloomy.li: A mage alone wears out. Let me bind {OTHER_nameDef} before I do.

cold.li: A familiar near a mage means more mana and fewer wounds. {OTHER_nameDef} is suitable. I need an hour.

plain.li: It's bound. I can feel where it is without looking.
Did you see it glow? That was the binding taking.

warm.li: We'll look after each other now, the two of us.

cheerful.li: It glows, faintly, but it really does glow.

cold.li: Bound. The mana comes easier already.

plain.li: Never mind the familiar. The hour never came.

gloomy.li: No familiar, then. I'll manage alone, as usual.

plain.li: I still need that hour with {OTHER_nameDef}, whenever the colony can spare me.

blunt.li: One quiet hour, and {OTHER_nameDef} is bound. That's all I'm asking.
